title: Creating SquashFS Images to Support HPC and AI Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2610.20578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: HPC users often download datasets on HPC systems for analysis and processing. When these datasets are comprised of hundreds of thousands (or more) of small files, accessing them in parallel can put a tremendous burden on the metadata servers of central parallel file systems. If the dataset is read-only, an effective solution is to compress the dataset into a SquashFS image. There are, however, a number of workflows that can be used to create such a dataset image, and we observed that some were more efficient than others. To provide more effective guidance for our userbase, we benchmarked eleven different workflows for creating SquashFS dataset image files of datasets with thousands to millions of very small files. We took into account whether the data arrived as tar.gz, zip, or files-and-directories downloads, whether the image creation was on the central file system or local compute node storage, and the number of SquashFS file compress

translated_title: 创建SquashFS镜像以支持HPC和AI数据集
translated_abstract: HPC用户经常在HPC系统上下载数据集用于分析和处理。当这些数据集由数十万（或更多）个小文件组成时，并行访问它们会给中央并行文件系统的元数据服务器带来巨大负担。如果数据集是只读的，一个有效的解决方案是将数据集压缩成SquashFS镜像。然而，存在多种可用于创建此类数据集镜像的工作流程，我们观察到其中一些比其他的更高效。为了给我们的用户提供更有效的指导，我们对十一种不同的工作流程进行了基准测试，这些工作流程用于创建包含数千到数百万个极小文件的数据集的SquashFS数据集镜像文件。我们考虑了数据是以tar.gz、zip还是文件和目录下载的形式到达、镜像创建是在中央文件系统上还是在本地计算节点存储上进行，以及SquashFS文件压缩的数量等因素。
tldr: 通过对十一种创建SquashFS数据集镜像的工作流程进行基准测试，为HPC用户提供了处理包含海量小文件的只读数据集的高效方案指导，以减轻并行文件系统元数据服务器的负担。
en_tdlr: Benchmarking eleven workflows for creating SquashFS dataset images with thousands to millions of small files, providing effective guidance for HPC users to reduce metadata server burden on parallel file systems.
